item.description:
Originally published Thu 01 Oct 2026 09:04 IDT.

item.title: [DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Wed 19:17): Drohnen-Erkennung | Arbeitsmarktzahlen | Munitionsfunde
item.description:
Originally published Wed 30 Sep 2026 19:17 IDT.
Schon mehrmals musste am BER der Flugverkehr wegen Drohnen unterbrochen werden. Damit das in Zukunft besser wird, bekommt der Flughafen ein neues Erkennungssystem. Außerdem: Arbeitsmarktzahlen Berlin und Brandenburg; Munitionsfunde in Potsdam gesprengt; Was passiert mit dem Wandlitzsee?   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Thu 18:25): US death row inmate survives execution attempt
item.description:
Originally published Thu 01 Oct 2026 18:25 IDT.

The US state of Tennessee fails to execute a woman on death row, who survived two lethal injection attempts. Christa Pike, who was convicted of murder thirty years ago, has been taken to hospital. The governor of Tennessee has ordered a temporary halt to executions.

Also: A sell-off in global bond markets intensifies; government forces in Ethiopia appear to have captured the strategic town of Alamata, in the Northern Tigray Region; Cubans living in Florida create a new organisation to plan for investment in a post-communist Cuba; Benjamin Netanyahu reacts to the apparent attempt to crash a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv; we hear from a critical care physician on working in Gaza; examining the winning entry of a prestigious scientific photography competition - was it made using AI? And on World Sake Day, we look at how sales of the drink have fallen in Japan.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
